label: Shielded — the wall itself
location: The desert hall, across the hatchery corridor
injuries: Carapace starred with cracks from blows taken over the tunnel mouths

recentEvents.value: She has become the wall between the intruder and the hatchery; her voice and the evacuation bells are the only sounds in the hall.

unresolvedConflicts.value: The hatchery is the one room she cannot evacuate quickly. He is walking toward it.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the corridor until the burrow-cities are empty beneath her.
